# insee.admin

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of `insee.admin` is to provide functions to prepare French administrative boundaries: linking hierarchical levels together and preparing `sf` files for each level.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `insee.admin` like so:

``` r
remotes::install_github("AcidyBee/insee.admin")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to prepare spatial data at various administrative granularities.

```{r example-setup, include = FALSE}
library(insee.admin)
# Example data is shipped with the package for reproducibility
path_to_extdata <- system.file("extdata", package = "insee.admin")
```

```{r example}
sf_COM <- pipeline_sf_admin_express_cog(path_to_extdata, layer = "COMMUNE")
sf_DEP <- pipeline_sf_admin_express_cog(path_to_extdata, layer = "DEPARTEMENT")
```

### Spatial data

Maps of Centre-Val de Loire region at various administrative granularities:

- DEPARTEMENT:

```{r, fig.alt = "Departments of Île-de-France and Centre-Val de Loire"}
sf_DEP %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(fill = "red", alpha = .5) +
  ggplot2::geom_sf_text(ggplot2::aes(label = dep_lib), size = 3) +
  ggplot2::coord_sf() +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```

- COMMUNE:

```{r, fig.alt = "Communes of Île-de-France and Centre-Val de Loire"}
sf_COM %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(fill = "red", alpha = .5) +
  ggplot2::coord_sf() +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```
